title: Stability of optimal transport maps and second variation of the 2-Monge-Kantorovich distance
summary: We establish several quantitative stability estimates for optimal transport maps between non-degenerate densities on uniformly convex domains for the quadratic cost. Under Hölder regularity assumptions, we prove Lipschitz $L^{2}$ (respectively $C^{0,α}$) stability estimates for optimal transport maps in terms of the $2$-Monge--Kantorovich distance (respectively $L^{p}$ distances) between pairs of source and target densities.
